gloss: playing and singing at the same time (esp. solo)

definitions.gloss: playing and singing at the same time (esp. solo)
definitions.explanation: A solo performance in which one person both plays an instrument (typically guitar or piano) and sings. The performer accompanies themselves, with no separate vocalist or backing band.

examples.japanese: ⟦ギター→ギター：04461_gitaa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{弾|ひ}き{語|がた}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I sing while playing the guitar.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ピアノ→ピアノ：01376_piano⟧{弾|ひ}き{語|がた}り⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{響|ひび}いた→響く：00099_hibiku⟧。
examples.english: Her piano-and-vocal performance struck a chord with me.

examples.japanese: ⟦ライブ→ライブ：05412_raibu⟧ハウス⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{若|わか}いミュージシャン⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{弾|ひ}き{語|がた}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{自作|じさく}→自作：13968_jisaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歌|うた}→歌：02179_uta⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{披露|ひろう}していた→披露する：20927_hirousuru⟧。
examples.english: At the live house, young musicians were performing their own songs solo on instrument and vocals.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{弾|ひ}く→弾く：02444_hiku⟧ (to play a stringed/keyed instrument) + ⟦{語|かた}る→語る：01930_kataru⟧ (to narrate, recite). The ⟦{語|かた}る→語る：01930_kataru⟧ element preserves an older sense of "singing a narrative," though today it covers any singing accompanied by self-played instrument.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ギター→ギター：04461_gitaa⟧{弾|ひ}き{語|がた}り: solo guitar-and-vocal performance
- ⟦ピアノ→ピアノ：01376_piano⟧{弾|ひ}き{語|がた}り: solo piano-and-vocal performance
- {弾|ひ}き{語|がた}り⟦ライブ→ライブ：05412_raibu⟧: a solo singer-musician live show
- {弾|ひ}き{語|がた}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歌|うた}う→歌う：00684_utau⟧: to sing while accompanying oneself

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{弾|ひ}く→弾く：02444_hiku⟧: to play (a stringed/keyed instrument) — just the playing
- ⟦{歌|うた}う→歌う：00684_utau⟧: to sing — just the singing
- アコースティック⟦ライブ→ライブ：05412_raibu⟧: acoustic live — overlapping but broader; may have multiple performers
